Subject Abduction of Chungking Government Agents in the French Concession
Made by D. I. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan
（批：Commr of Police Sir: Information. R.W. Forke. D.C. (Sp. Br.) 3/9.）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 4 SEPT 1940）
FILE
（批：le 4/7 b/44 G.T.）
At 11 p.m. August 30, 1940, an abduction took place in the vicinity of Avenue Joffre and Rte. G. de Boissezon, French Concession which involved the following four secret agents of the Chungking Government:-
1) Wong Teh Bing (王德平 ), Committee member of the local Tangpu of the Chungking Government and concurrently an executive of the Shanghai Branch of the San Min Chu I Youths Corps;
2) Chiang Mong Ling (姜夢麟 ), Chief of the Intelligence Section of the Tangpu;
3) Wong Ko Wei (王果為 ), alias Weng Jang (王強 ), Chief of the Cable Section of the Tangpu and a well-known amateur basketball player locally; and
4) One named Wang (汪), a secretary of the Tangpu.
The four were carried away in two motor cars (lic. No. unknown) by a group of seven armed male Chinese from No. 76 Jessfield Road, O.C.L., who waylaid them and forced them into the said motor cars when they approached the aforementioned locality, afterwards driving away in a westerly direction.
It is reported that the incident is the result of the defection of Wong Teh Bing (1st named) who is said to have reached an understanding with Wang Ching Wei regime while he was Acting Chairman of the executive Committee of the local Tangpu, following the departure of Mr. Wu Chao Shu (吳紹樹 ) for the war-time capital in Chungking in June this year. （批注：le 4/7 b/44 G.T.）
1940年8月30日晚11时，法租界霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）与贝当路（Rte. G. de Boissezon）附近发生了一起绑架事件，涉及以下四名重庆政府秘密特工：
1) 王德平（Wong Teh Bing），重庆政府当地党部委员，兼三民主义青年团上海分团干事；
2) 姜梦麟（Chiang Mong Ling），党部情报科科长；
3) 王果为（Wong Ko Wei），化名王强（Weng Jang），党部电讯科科长，本地知名业余篮球运动员；以及
4) 一名姓汪（Wang）者，党部秘书。
这四人是被一群七名持枪中国男子从极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）76号（O.C.L.）开来的两辆汽车（车牌号不详）带走的。当上述四人走近前述地点时，这伙人伏击了他们，强迫他们进入所述汽车，随后向西驶离。
据报，此事件是王德平（第一名）叛变的结果。据说，今年6月吴绍树（Wu Chao Shu）先生前往战时陪都重庆后，王德平在担任当地党部执行委员会代理主席期间，已与汪精卫政权达成谅解。王是一名留日归国学生，且

September 15, 1940.
Morning Translation

The following notice published by the
Political Police Bureau of the Ministry of Police of the
Nanking Government appears in the Central China Daily News,
Bing Pao and Kuo Min Daily News to-day :-

MEMBERS OF SHANGHAI BRANCH OF CHUNGKING SAN-MIN-CHU-I
YOUTHS CORPS SURRENDER TO NANKING GOVERNMENT

Realizing the mistake of the policy of the
war of resistance and admiring the greatness of the peace
movement, Yi Bei-yung (易培文), Chief Secretary of the
Shanghai Branch of the Chungking San-Min-Chu-I Youths Corps,
Lu Jih (呂 哲), Chief of the Organization and Training
Section, Kiang Maung-ling (姜夢麟), Chief of the
Intelligence Section, Wong Ko-wei (王果為), Chief of the
General Affairs Section, and Chang Su-chung (張素忠),
Captain of the Movement Section, have surrendered to the
Political Police Bureau. Photographs and books with the
names of the entire body of members of the San-Min-Chu-I
Youths Corps, important documents, wireless receiving and
transmitting sets etc. have been handed over by them to the
Bureau in proof of their sincerity. Furthermore, they have
stated frankly that they had been utilized by others in the
assassination by the Corps of Lu Yoh (魯 約), Hu Sze-tien
(胡斯典), Wong Pao-nyoh (王寶玉) and other comrades
taking part in the peace movement and for which they express
their regret.

In conformity with the generosity of the
Government, the Political Police Bureau has accorded these
men good treatment and will appoint them to important positions
so that all may co-operate together in dealing with the present
difficult situation.

Upon reading through the books received,
it was discovered that most of the members of the Corps are
young people still in school who had been misled by others.
It is hoped that they will follow the example of Messrs. Yi,
Lu etc. and voluntarily surrender to the peace movement. The
Political Police Bureau will overlook their past deeds but if
they hesitate, it will be too late for them to repent.
This notice is hereby published for their
information.

Li Shih-chung (李士群),
Chief of the Political Police Bureau,
Ma Siao-tien (馬嘯天),
Deputy Chief of the Political Police Bureau,
September 15, 1940.

晨间译文

南京政府警政部政治警察总局发布的下列通告，今日刊登于《华中日报》、《平报》及《国民日报》：

重庆三民主义青年团上海分团成员向南京政府投诚

鉴于认识到抗战政策的错误，并仰慕和平运动的伟大，重庆三民主义青年团上海分团主任秘书易培文（Yi Bei-yung）、组训科科长吕哲（Lu Jih）、情报科科长姜梦麟（Kiang Maung-ling）、总务科科长王果为（Wong Ko-wei）以及行动队队长张素忠（Chang Su-chung），已向政治警察总局投诚。为证明其诚意，他们已向该局移交了载有三民主义青年团全体成员姓名的名册和书籍、重要文件、无线收发报机等。此外，他们坦承曾受他人利用，参与了青年团对鲁约（Lu Yoh）、胡斯典（Hu Sze-tien）、王宝玉（Wong Pao-nyoh）及其他参加和平运动同志的暗杀行动，对此他们表示悔恨。

本着政府的宽大精神，政治警察总局已给予这些人优待，并将任命他们担任重要职务，以便大家共同合作，应对当前的困难局面。

经查阅收到的名册，发现该团大多数成员仍是受他人误导的在校青年。希望他们能效仿易先生、吕先生等人的榜样，自愿向和平运动投诚。政治警察总局将既往不咎，但若犹豫不决，则悔之晚矣。
特此发布此通告，以资周知。

政治警察总局局长李士群（Li Shih-chung），
政治警察总局副局长马啸天（Ma Siao-tien），

September 15, 1940. Morning Translation

(1) That a letter be sent to the Settlement authorities asking them to request Mr. Yu Ya-ching to place on the Shanghai market the 100,000 bags of foreign rice which had been bought for the cheap sales in Ningpo so as to pacify the people in Shanghai and to increase the stocks.
(2) That a letter be sent again to the Bean and Rice Dealers Guild and the Provision Dealers Guild requesting that a meeting of members be held to advise on the joint purchase of foreign rice.
The meeting held the view that the Shanghai Rice Price Adjustment Committee should be made stronger and that more effective measures should be adopted.

Chinese-American Daily News, National Herald, Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao, Bing Pao, Central China Daily News :-

Food Supply Question Waiting For Settlement

Although communications between Shanghai and Indo-China are normal, the private quotations of rice on the mart are still going up. The Rice Price Adjustment Committee has now been in existence for nearly two months. Although it has raised the price limit on several occasions so far it has not secured very satisfactory results. Nobody is observing the price limit. A resolution was passed at the meeting held by the Shanghai Rice Price Adjustment Committee on September 13 to the effect that the meeting held the view that the fixing of a price limit would not be made until the Settlement authorities could submit means to remedy the situation. Henceforth the price of rice in this city will go up or fall indiscriminately which will affect food supply question.
The Ministry of Economics has ordered Chambers of Commerce in the cities and provinces to warn people severely against manipulation and speculation. The main points of the order are as follows :-
(1) Those who refuse to permit an investigation or who give false information.
(2) Those who sell daily necessaries at a price which is not according to the published price limit.
(3) Those whose reports regarding the orders of the Ministry of Economics are not true.
(4) Those who raise the prices of commodities which are not really sold by them, with a view to making profit.
Owing to the special circumstances prevailing in this city, speculators and manipulators pay no heed to the orders of the government. It is regrettable that the orders of the government cannot be enforced in this city. The authorities of the two Foreign Settlements should take effective measures to remedy the food situation, as they are responsible for maintaining peace and order within the Settlements. Our countrymen must obey the orders of the government and the public bodies concerned must try to stabilize the food supply. If the people can have enough food, the country will be saved.

《中美日报》、《申报》、《新闻报》、《顺报》、《平报》、《华中日报》：

粮食供应问题待解决

尽管上海与印度支那之间的交通正常，但市场上的大米私人报价仍在上涨。米价调整委员会成立已近两个月。虽然迄今已数次提高限价，但并未取得非常令人满意的结果。无人遵守限价规定。上海米价调整委员会在9月13日的会议上通过一项决议，认为在租界当局提出补救局势的措施之前，暂不制定限价。此后，本市米价将随意涨跌，这将影响粮食供应问题。
经济部已命令各省市商会严厉警告民众不得操纵市场和投机倒把。命令要点如下：
(1) 拒绝接受调查或提供虚假信息者。
(2) 未按公布限价出售日常必需品者。
(3) 关于经济部命令的报告不实者。
(4) 并未真正出售商品却抬高价格以牟利者。
由于本市特殊情况，投机商和操纵者无视政府命令。遗憾的是，政府命令在本市无法执行。两外国租界当局应承担维持租界内和平与秩序的责任，采取有效措施改善粮食状况。我国同胞必须服从政府命令，有关公共机构必须努力稳定粮食供应。如果人民有足够的食物，国家就得救了。

SEP 1940

Claim "Surrender"
Japanese Say
San Min Chu I
Heads Join Up

The local organization of the San
Min Chu I (Three People's Princi-
ples) Youth Society, a Chungking
organ, is on the verge of collapse
as five leaders of the organization
on Friday evening gave themselves
up to the Shanghai office of the
Political Affairs Section of the
Ministry of Police of the National
Government of China, the Tairiku
Shimpo reported yesterday.
Chi Pei-wen, chief secretary; Lu
Che, chief of the direction and or-
ganization section; Wang Ko-wei,
chief of the general affairs section;
Chiang Meng-lin, chief of the in-
formation section, and Chang Shu-
chun, chief of the action party,
surrendered themselves to join the
peace and national reconstruction
movement, the Japanese daily said.
They also handed over to the
police authorities of the Nanking
Government the names of 800 mem-
bers of the San Min Chu I Youth
Society in Shanghai, it was report-
ed by the daily.

1940年9月

声称“投诚”
日本人称
三民主义青年团
首领加入

据《大陆新报》昨日报道，重庆机构三民主义青年团的地方组织正处于崩溃边缘，因为该组织的五名领导人于周五晚间向中国国家政府警政部政务科上海办事处自首。
该日文日报称，主任秘书季培文（Chi Pei-wen）、指导组织科科长吕哲（Lu Che）、总务科科长王果为（Wong Ko-wei）、情报科科长姜梦麟（Chiang Meng-lin）以及行动队队长张书春（Chang Shu-chun）已自首，加入和平建国运动。
据该日报报道，他们还向南京政府警察当局移交了上海三民主义青年团800名成员的名单。
